wording.why: Near misses will feel bad under time pressure: Gangplank, Lissandra, Seraphine and Tahm Kench all have 9 letters; Jarvan IV has 8.
wording.suggestion: Count only the letters in the champion's official name, across every word (Twisted Fate has 11; Gangplank has 9, so it doesn't count).

wording.why: 'Monkey King' (10 letters) is Wukong's well-known alternate name; the official name Wukong has 6.
wording.suggestion: Mention in the Rule that only the official name counts (Wukong, not Monkey King).

fun.why: Heimerdinger and Fiddlesticks are instant, and counting letters under time pressure is fiddly with frustrating 9-letter near misses; 11 answers gives a modest tail.

champion:AurelionSol.why: Long two-word name, often thought of.

champion:TwistedFate.why: Two-word names come up for those counting across words.

champion:Nunu.why: Thought of as 'Nunu' (4); the full name counts.

champion:Renata.why: Players say 'Renata' (6); the full name is needed.

gemCandidates.why: Players think 'Nunu' is short; 'Nunu & Willump' has 11 letters, a great 'oh of course'. 0.15, bottom half.
Maintainer's suggestion holds: a 10-letter single word people call 'Trynd' and forget. 0.15, bottom half.
